title: BanglaMamba: Exploring State Space Models for Bangla Fake News Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.25190v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fake news detection has become an important Natural Language Processing (NLP) task due to the rapid spread of misinformation through online news platforms and social media. While transformer-based models such as BanglaBERT achieve strong performance for Bangla text classification, their quadratic computational complexity makes them less suitable for long-document processing in resource-constrained environments. This paper investigates Mamba-based State Space Models (SSMs) as an efficient alternative for Bangla fake news detection. translated_title: BanglaMamba：探索状态空间模型用于孟加拉语假新闻检测
translated_abstract: 假新闻检测已成为自然语言处理（NLP）中的一项重要任务，因为错误信息通过在线新闻平台和社交媒体迅速传播。尽管基于Transformer的模型（如BanglaBERT）在孟加拉语文本分类中表现出色，但其二次计算复杂度使其在资源受限环境中处理长文档时不太适用。本文研究了基于Mamba的状态空间模型（SSMs）作为孟加拉语假新闻检测的高效替代方案。我们提出了BanglaMamba，并将其与预训练的BanglaBERT和从头训练的类似配置的BERT模型进行比较。实验结果表明，BanglaBERT取得了最高的Macro-F1分数（0.9260），而BanglaMamba（0.9029）尽管使用不同的架构，其性能与从头训练的CustomBERT（0.9057）相当。同时，BanglaMamba实现了约2.2倍的更高效率。
tldr: 本文提出BanglaMamba，一种基于状态空间模型的孟加拉语假新闻检测方法，在保持与从头训练BERT相当性能的同时，实现了约2.2倍的计算效率提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BanglaMamba, a state-space-model-based method for Bangla fake news detection, achieving comparable performance to a from-scratch BERT while being approximately 2.2 times more computationally efficient.
